name: ip-watch
author: Takaro
description: IP Watch: an anti-cheat helper. When a player joins from a new IP, it checks if that IP is shared with other players (possible alt or shared account), if the country changed, and optionally if the IP is a VPN or proxy. By default it only alerts admins in game (IP_WATCH_ALERTS) and optionally in a Discord channel; each rule can also kick or ban. Admins can run ipcheck <player>. Raw IPs are masked by default.

discordChannelId.title: Discord channel id
discordChannelId.description: Optional. Discord channel id that also receives alerts. Leave empty for in-game alerts only. The domain needs a connected Discord bot with access to this channel.

sharedIpCheck.title: Check shared IPs
sharedIpCheck.description: Alert when a player's new IP was also used by other players on this domain (possible alt or shared account).

sharedIpAction.title: Shared IP action
sharedIpAction.description: What to do besides alerting when a shared IP is found.

countryChangeCheck.title: Check country changes
countryChangeCheck.description: Alert when a player connects from a different country than last time.

countryChangeAction.title: Country change action
countryChangeAction.description: What to do besides alerting when the country changed.

vpnCheck.title: Check VPN / proxy
vpnCheck.description: Off by default. Looks up each new IP with an IP reputation API. Takaro Cloud only allows outbound requests to allowlisted hosts: ask Takaro support to allow the API host (for example proxycheck.io) before you turn this on, or the lookup is blocked and skipped.

vpnProvider.title: VPN API provider
vpnProvider.description: Which response format the VPN API uses. proxycheck = proxycheck.io v2 (free tier with an API key). ipapi = ip-api.com (proxy and hosting fields).

vpnApiUrl.title: VPN API URL
vpnApiUrl.description: Optional. Overrides the provider's default URL. Use {ip} and {key} as placeholders. Empty = provider default.

vpnApiKey.title: VPN API key
vpnApiKey.description: API key for the VPN provider. Get a free proxycheck.io key at https://proxycheck.io.

vpnAction.title: VPN action
vpnAction.description: What to do besides alerting when the IP is a VPN or proxy.

identityConflictAlert.title: Alert on identity conflicts
identityConflictAlert.description: Alert when Takaro finds that one connection matches more than one player record (for example the same Steam id on two players).

nameChangeAlert.title: Alert on name changes
nameChangeAlert.description: Alert when a player connects with a new name.

whitelist.title: Whitelist
whitelist.description: Player names, Takaro player ids or platform ids (Steam, Epic, Xbox) that IP Watch ignores.

showFullIp.title: Show full IP in alerts
showFullIp.description: When off (default), alerts and ipcheck show a masked IP like 203.0.x.x. Only players with IP_WATCH_ALERTS or IP_WATCH_MANAGE ever see IPs.

kickBanReason.title: Kick / ban reason
kickBanReason.description: Reason shown to the player when a rule kicks or bans them.
kickBanReason.default: Your connection was flagged by the server's anti-cheat. Contact an admin.

banDuration.title: Ban duration
banDuration.description: How long a ban lasts when a rule bans.

permissions.description: Online players with this permission get IP Watch alerts as private messages.
Allows the ipcheck command, which shows a player's known IPs, shared IPs and last country.
IP Watch never alerts on, kicks or bans players with this permission.

ipcheck.description: Show a player's known IP count, players sharing an IP, and last country.

new-ip.description: Checks a new IP for sharing, country change and (optionally) VPN, then alerts and applies the configured action.

identity-conflict.description: Alerts admins when one connection matches more than one player record.

new-name.description: Alerts admins on name changes when nameChangeAlert is on.
